An English crib of the Latin text, semi-literal, made for this database in 2026 with Claude, a large language model (LLM) made by Anthropic. It keeps close to the wording of the original and uses the established English of Anglo-Latin legal, liturgical and canon-law formulae. It is an aid to reading the original, not a published translation. Square brackets mark Liebermann’s additions to the text or, now and then, words supplied for the sense; “[?]” marks a doubtful reading

div.head: ECf 39.2
div.ab: Quas consuetudines iustas et sapienter ductas non auferimus eis: tantum in mercatis emant cum testibus et cognitione uenditorum.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 670 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.
This is the last clause of ECf.

note.seg: d. i. Verfasser (unter Wilhelms I. Maske?), nicht die angebliche Angelsächs. Jury von 1070 im Prolog und 34, 1
i.e. the author (in the mask of William I?), not the alleged Anglo-Saxon jury of 1070 in the Prologue and 34, 1
bestehen bleiben die älteren drei Cautelen seit Hl 16, vor Einführung der Gewährbürgen: auf offenem Markt, mit Kaufzeugen und nicht ohne die Verkäufer zu kennen
the three older safeguards, in force since Hl 16, before the introduction of warrantor-sureties, remain: in the open market, with witnesses to the purchase, and not without knowing the sellers
emptis (lies ematis?) Hk S; emptas Hr
emptis (read ematis?) Hk S; emptas Hr
et c. u. lacking in Hr
enden Rl Hk; Expliciunt leges Edwardi et Willelmi regum Anglie fügt zu Hr; folgt gleich wie ferneres Capitel Libertas ciuitatum, d. i. Lib. Lond u. S. 673, Pl S
Rl Hk end here; Hr adds Expliciunt leges Edwardi et Willelmi regum Anglie; in Pl S there follows at once, as if a further chapter, Libertas ciuitatum, i.e. Lib. Lond, below p. 673

div.ab: These customs, just and wisely established, we do not take away from them: only let them buy in markets with witnesses and with the knowledge of the sellers.
